qa_pairs.question: What percentage of consumers in 2025 are both aware of packaged drinking water and most frequently purchase Nongfu Spring Mineral Water? Answer in percentage, rounded to 2 decimal places. Answer: xx.xx%
qa_pairs.explanation: The proportion of consumers aware of packaged drinking water is 51.00% × the proportion of those who most frequently purchase Nongfu Spring Mineral Water is 48.53% = 0.51 × 0.4853 = 0.247503. Rounded to 2 decimal places, it is 24.75%.

qa_pairs.question: Assuming independent distribution, what percentage of consumers in 2025 are both aware of packaged drinking water and drink packaged drinking water more than 5 times a week? Answer in percentage, rounded to 2 decimal places. Answer: xx%
qa_pairs.explanation: The proportion of consumers aware of packaged drinking water is 51.00% × the proportion of those who drink more than 5 times a week is 11.26% = 0.51 × 0.1126 = 0.057426. Rounded to 2 decimal places, it is 5.74%.

qa_pairs.question: Assuming independent distribution, what percentage of packaged drinking water consumers in 2025 drink 1 - 2 times a week and give a 5 - point rating in the brand awareness dimension? Answer in percentage, rounded to 2 decimal places. Answer: xx%
qa_pairs.explanation: The proportion of consumers who drink 1 - 2 times a week is 49.60% × the proportion of those who give a 5 - point rating in brand awareness is 41.55% = 0.4960 × 0.4155 = 0.206088. Rounded to 2 decimal places, it is 20.61%.

answer.E: In the awareness of beverage categories, the awareness rate of packaged drinking water is relatively high, which may directly support its dominant position in consumption frequency.
